//: Shape only. Copy to appsettings.Development.json (local) or supply via user-secrets / environment variables / Key Vault (QA/prod). Never commit real secrets.

Auth.//: Authentication + identity settings. Secrets (SigningKey, AcsConnectionString, SendGridApiKey) are placeholders here — supply real values via user-secrets locally and the platform secret store (Key Vault) in the cloud. Never commit real secrets.

Token.//: JWT access/refresh token issuance and verification. SigningKey must be >= 32 bytes (256 bits) for HMAC-SHA256. Lifetimes are TimeSpans ('d.hh:mm:ss').

Google.//: Google (OIDC) sign-in. ClientId is the OAuth client id enforced as the required audience of every Google assertion.

Email.//: Transactional email. Provider is one of 'Console' (local; logs only, no external connection), 'AzureCommunicationServices', or 'SendGrid'. The cloud transports require FromAddress plus their own secret.

EmailVerification.//: Verification-token validity. Must be between 1 hour ('01:00:00') and 7 days ('7.00:00:00'); default 24 hours.

PasswordReset.//: Reset-token validity (<= 60 minutes) plus the anti-enumeration rate limit.

SignInProtection.//: Optional hardening; both gates off by default. When LockoutEnabled is true, MaxFailedAttempts and LockoutWindow must be positive.

RatingEngine.//: Optional. Tunes the OpenSkill PlackettLuce rating engine. Omit any key to use its default (shown below). The whole section may be omitted to run on all defaults. No secrets here.
